newsitem.title: LATVIA: EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH25.
newsitem.headline: EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH25.

text.p: These were the headlines on Latvian state radio in early afternoon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Riga mayor elections are to go into the second round with Andris Berzinsh of the Latvia's Way and Andris Gulbis of the Social Democrats to compete for the post.
- Indian ambassador Sushil Dubey has pressented his credentials to the Latvian President Guntis Ulmanis.
